title: Spring rain beating time as whistles of warblers call day to awaken yet time nestles away hiding in clouds once more #poemsofpresence
summary: Spring rain beating time as whistles of warblers call day to awaken yet time nestles away hiding in clouds once more #poemsofpresence
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
Spring rain
beating time
as whistles
of warblers
call day
to awaken
  yet time
nestles away
hiding in clouds
once more
#poemsofpresence
